#### BIENVENIDOS A LA PRIMER PARADA DE LA RUTA CUBERA 2025, IZCALLI CLÁSICO
Después de 6 años México regresa a tener una ruta cubera, por 3 ciudadades alrededor del país, siendo la primera Cuautitlán Izcalli en el Estado de México, con nuestro querido torneo Clásico!
Habrá sorpresas para todos aquellos que completen la Ruta Cubera 2025, así que no dejes que se te vaya la primer parada, prepara tus mejores 3x3 y 2x2, te esperamos en Izcalli!.

Un agradecimiento especial a las FES-Cuautitlán UNAM por las facilidades y apoyo para realizar este evento, y al Team Izcalli por el compromiso para poderlo llevar a cabo.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia.[](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).

#### WELCOME TO THE FIRST STOP OF THE CUBER ROUTE 2025, IZCALLI CLASICO
After 6 years, Mexico returns to have a cuba route, through 3 cities around the country, the first being Cuautitlán Izcalli in the State of Mexico, with our beloved Classic tournament!
There will be surprises for all those who complete the Cuber 2025 Route, so don't let the first stop pass you by, prepare your best 3x3 and 2x2, we are waiting for you in Izcalli!

We thank the FES-Cuautitlán UNAM for the facilities and support to hold this event and to the izcalli team for the commitment to be able to carry it out.

This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the WCA regulations before the competition. [](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcnlIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--332177ea99a8c8d5f8b82db10b1ac1f7c00234a9/io%20(1).png)
###### Español 
¡Bienvenidos al Ameca Nayarit 2025, la primera competencia oficial en el hermoso entorno costero y tropical de Nuevo Nayarit, y la segunda en el municipio de Bahía de Banderas! Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo los dias 18 y 19 de enero del 2025.

A medida que el río fluye, también lo hará la emoción de ver a los competidores resolver el cubo Rubik con asombrosa rapidez. Prepárense para estas jornadas inolvidables llenas de ingenio y velocidad.

Esta competencia es organizada por la comunidad de Vallarta Speed.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

###### English
Welcome to the Ameca Nayarit 2025, the first official competition in the beautiful coastal and tropical environment of Nuevo Nayarit, and the second in the municipality of Bahía de Banderas! This exciting and fast-paced event will take place on January 18 and 19, 2025.

As the river flows, so will the thrill of watching competitors solve the Rubik's Cube with astonishing speed. Get ready for these unforgettable days full of ingenuity and speed.

This competition is organized by the Vallarta Speed community.

This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.name: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu I 2025
items.information:
Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju.

---

Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information:
### 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대기자 명단에 등록됩니다.
### 신청 후 [참가자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/55/competitors)에서 본인의 이름을 확인하십시오. 이름이 보이지 않을 경우 [대기자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/55/waitlist)을 확인하여 주십시오.
### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다.

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.
원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___
### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist.
### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/55/competitors). Please check the [wait list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/55/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list.
### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers.

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

[EN]

### OCDSB Students!

OCDSB students (Elementary and Secondary students) compete for free! Please add the following note in the comments of your registration: "OCDSB Student, my student email is {student email here}" Please do not pay the registration fee.

### Ottawa Mini Winter Series

This competition is in a series with [Ottawa Mini Winter A 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OttawaMiniWinterA2025) (Friday Evening) and [Ottawa Mini Winter C 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OttawaMiniWinterC2025) (Saturday Afternoon). You will only be able to compete in one of these three competitions. Attempting to register for multiple of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

### Registration Reminders

If you are not a OCDSB student, you must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.


---

[FR]

### Les élèves de l'OCDSB!

Les élèves de l'OCDSB (élèves du primaire et du secondaire) participent gratuitement aux compétitions! Veuillez ajouter la note suivante dans les commentaires de votre inscription: "Étudiant de l'OCDSB, mon email d'étudiant est {email d'étudiant ici}". Ne payez pas les frais d'inscription.

### Série d'hiver d'Ottawa

Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Ottawa Mini Winter A 2025 (vendredi soir) et Ottawa Mini Winter C 2025 (samedi après-midi). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à une seule de ces trois compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plusieurs de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée.

### Rappels concernant l'inscription

Si vous n'êtes pas un étudiant de l'OCDSB, vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails.

### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.name: Chill Out Trondheim 2025
items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Chill Out Trondheim 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).


---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Chill Out Trondheim 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.

### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

Mira Labs is excited to announce our inaugural WCA competition, **Mira Labs Cubing Scientists in Bacolod 2025**!

This event welcomes participants of all ages and skill levels, with generous cut-off times to encourage broader participation. The 3x3x3 cube, our main event, will feature three thrilling rounds, while the 2x2x2 cube will have two rounds. To revive the community’s interest in specialized categories, we’re also offering two rounds for Clock and Square-1, while the remaining events will each feature a single, intense round.

By registering, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge that the organizing bodies, their staff, and affiliated individuals will not be liable for any injuries, loss of personal belongings, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this event.

Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating in this event.

items.information:
### On the spot registration is open for 2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb events only.


Kejuaraan Speedcubing Nasional untuk Indonesia pada tahun 2024. Peserta dari segala usia dan kewarganegaraan dipersilakan untuk mengikuti.
Harap diperhatikan tentang limit dan cutoff untuk setiap event, karena lebih ketat daripada kompetisi biasanya.

Akan ada **2 jenis pemenang** dalam kompetisi ini:
**Kategori Terbuka** - 3 pemenang teratas kompetisi tanpa memandang kewarganegaraan
**Kategori Indonesia** - 3 pemenang teratas yang mewakili Indonesia di setiap kategori

Peserta atau pendamping harus setuju bahwa penyelenggara, NSA, dan WCA tidak bertanggung jawab atas cedera pribadi, atau kerusakan atau kehilangan barang pribadi anda yang diakibatkan oleh partisipasi Anda dalam acara ini.
Untuk informasi lebih lanjut, silakan periksa **Persyaratan Pendaftaran.**
Biaya pendaftaran termasuk, Sertifikat Partisipasi, Lanyard, dan Name Tag.
Silahkan melakukan registrasi di website WCA dan konfirmasi di [form ini](https://forms.gle/h89T8gudSJRxWPaF9)

*Harap perhatikan jadwal selama periode pendaftaran terbuka karena dapat berubah tergantung pada jumlah orang yang mendaftar untuk setiap acara.*

---

### Registrasi OTS dibuka hanya untuk cabang 2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx, dan Skewb.

The National Speedcubing Championship for Indonesia in 2024. Competitiors of all ages and nationality are welcomed to join.
Please notice the time limit and cutoff on each events, as they are stricter than regular competitions.

There will be **2 types of winners** in this competition:
**Open Category** - Top 3 winners of the competition regardless of nationality
**Indonesian Category** - Top 3 winners representing the Indonesia in each category

Competitor or guardian must agree that the organizers, NSA and WCA shall not be liable for any personal injury, property damage or loss resulting from your participation of this event.
For more information, please check the **Registration Requirements.**
Registration fee includes, Certificate of Participation, Lanyard and Name Tag.
Please register in the WCA website and confirm your registration by filling out [this form](https://forms.gle/h89T8gudSJRxWPaF9)

*Please keep an eye on our schedule during the open registration period as it may change depending on the number of people registering for each event.*

# **ESPAÑOL**

Te invitamos a una serie de mini competencias que se llevarán a cabo en San Luis Potosí, totalmente gratuitas. Estas competencias están diseñadas para ofrecer a los participantes una experiencia divertida y relajada, ideal tanto para principiantes como para aquellos que quieran mejorar sus habilidades. ¡No pierdas la oportunidad de unirte y disfrutar de esta emocionante serie de eventos!.
Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.


# **ENGLISH**

We invite you to a series of mini competitions that will take place in San Luis Potosí, completely free of charge. These competitions are designed to offer participants a fun and relaxed experience, ideal for beginners as well as those who want to improve their skills. Don’t miss the chance to join and enjoy this exciting series of events!
This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) prior to competition.

items.name: Cape Cubes Challenge 2024
items.information:
CubingZA is excited to announce the final Cape Town competition for 2024 - Cape Cubes Challenge! This competition will focus on a variety of popular events across two days.
Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" section, and pay for your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below.

Please keep in mind that we **will not** be accepting on-the-day registration. We are going to be using printed nametags and the Competition Groups website for competitor roles and duties and to do this we will need to close the registration period before the competition begins. 

A huge thanks to [Speedcubes](www.speedcubes.co.za) for sponsoring this competition! Please see the Sponsors tab for more information, and make sure to support the Speedcubes shop at the competition.
![Speedcubes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5NDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--f899ecbbd498c3dd38ea30276772dcc02470011a/NEW_SPEEDCUBE_LOGO_BLACK.webp)

**SPECTATORS**
Competitors are welcome to bring up to two spectators with them.

**VOLUNTEERING**
Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

items.name: Centennial State Cube Off 2024
items.information:
We're excited to welcome competitors back to Erie for another fun day of speedcubing!

Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important!

This competition has a 100 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition!
Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. 
If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 7:45 AM.
If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (11:00 PM UTC 12-06-2024)
This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

items.information:
##### 🇧🇷
O **Pé Vermelho II** é a segunda edição do nosso campeonato **aberto** e **beneficente**. Aqui estão algumas instruções e lembretes para quem pretende participar:

* Todas as informações sobre inscrição no evento podem ser encontradas na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024/register).
* As inscrições vão até o dia **07/12/2024**, ou até que o **limite de 70 competidores** seja atingido. Após essa data, só será possível a inscrição no dia do campeonato, caso haja vagas remanescentes.
* Fique atento aos horários de credenciamento na aba [Cronograma](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024#competition-schedule). Chegue com antecedência para fazer seu credenciamento antes de qualquer modalidade que você for participar.
* Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento.
* É necessário que todos os participantes leiam o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição.
* O cubo com o qual você vai competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição.
* Caso seja seu primeiro campeonato, assista [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE).
* Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal.
* Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Mande suas dúvidas para a [organização](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com) e faremos o melhor possível para ajudar. Sempre há espaço para novos competidores!
* Divirta-se!

---

##### 🇺🇸
**Pé Vermelho II** is the second edition of our **open charity** competition. Here are some instructions and reminders for those who wish to participate:

* All information regarding registration can be found in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024/register) tab.
* Registration closes on **12/07/2024**, or whenever the **limit of 70 competitors** is reached. After that, it will only be possible to register in the day of the competition, if there are still vacancies.
* Pay attention to check-in times in the [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024#competition-schedule) tab. Please arrive early in order to check-in before participating in any event.
* All competitors must present a valid document at the check-in.
* All participants must read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
* The cube with which you will compete must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, your cube may not be approved for the competition.
* If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE).
* There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian.
* If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. You can e-mail your questions to the [organization](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com), and we will do our best to help you. There is always room for new speedcubers!
* Have fun!

---

### 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대기자 명단에 등록됩니다.
### 신청 후 [참가자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/53/competitors)에서 본인의 이름을 확인하십시오. 이름이 보이지 않을 경우 [대기자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/53/waitlist)을 확인하여 주십시오.
### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다.

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.
원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___
### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist.
### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/53/competitors). Please check the [wait list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/53/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list.
### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers.

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

items.information:
### WCAシリーズ大会
「Shonan AM/PM 2024」はWCAシリーズ大会です。
WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。
複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。

このページは「Shonan AM/PM 2024」の「AM大会」のページです。
　・ [Shonan AM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ShonanAM2024)(**このページでは「AM大会」と表記**)
　・ [Shonan PM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ShonanPM2024)(**このページでは「PM大会」と表記**)

各大会の種目、ラウンド数、開場時刻、定員は以下の通りです。
　・AM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 1ラウンド、2x2x2 キューブ 1ラウンド　開場時刻 9:10　定員80名
　・PM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 1ラウンド、3x3x3 片手 1ラウンド　開場時刻 14:10　定員80名

### 当日の来場時刻
AM大会については、**必ず**受付時間内の9:10から9:40の間にお越しください。
PM大会については、開場時刻の14:10までは会場に入れません。**必ず**14:10から14:40の間にお越しください。
※会場は一般の企業も使用するオフィスビルのため、**会場前の廊下など建物内での待機はできません。**

### 参加費の支払い方法
参加費は受付時にお支払いください。
支払い方法は現金のみです。

### 同伴・見学
会場定員の都合上、同伴・見学は承認制をとっています。
今大会の同伴・見学は**1名まで** 、つまり**競技参加者と同伴者の合計2名**でのご来場となります。申込時に同伴者の有無を申告してください。**事前申請のない来場は入場をお断りする場合があります。**

申請の承認は申し込み期間終了後に来場希望総数を集計してから決定いたします。
希望者が多数の場合は年少者の保護者などを優先的に承認することがあります。あらかじめご了承ください。

### ジャッジ・スクランブラー等の役割分担
WCA大会では、ご自身の競技参加のほか、他者の競技スタッフとしてジャッジやスクランブラ―をはじめとした役割が割り振られます。個人ごとの役割分担表は参加申し込み締め切り後にお伝えします。

競技参加者が年少者の場合など、自身での担当が困難なときには保護者などに代理でご協力いただくことがあります。具体的な作業の流れを確認する時間を大会当日に設けますので、不慣れな方は必ずご参加ください。
関連競技規則[1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/japanese/#1e2)および
競技規則[1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/japanese/#1f2)


### WCA Series Competitions
Shonan AM/PM 2024 are recongnized as WCA series competitions.
WCA series competitions are a series of multiple competitions. You can participate in  **only one** of them.
If you register for more than one competition in a series, only the earliest registration will be valid, and the others will be invalid.

This page is for Shonan AM 2024.
　[Shonan AM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ShonanAM2024) (**In this page, called "AM"**)
　[Shonan PM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ShonanPM2024)  (**In this page, called "PM"**)

The events, number of rounds, opening time, and maximum number of players for each event are as follows:
　AM : 3x3x3 Cube 1 round, 2x2x2 Cube 1 round, open at 9:10, limit of competitors 80
　PM : 3x3x3 Cube 1 round, 3x3x3 One-Handed 1 round, open at 14:10, limit of competitors 80
 
### Arrival Information
For the AM competition, **please be sure to arrive during check-in hours between 9:10 and 9:40.**
For the PM competition, **please be sure to arrive during check-in hours between 14:10 and 14:40.** Competitors won't be allowed to enter until 14:10. 
*Other business company office is near the venue. Do not stay in the building hallway before check-in. 


### How to pay the participation fee
Please pay the participation fee at check-in.
Payment must be made in cash only.

### Limit of non-competitor Guest
Guest entry requires approval due to venue capacity.
Each competitor may request bringing up to one non-competitor guest with prior declaration on the registration.  **Guest without prior application may be refused entry. **

Approval of your request will be determined after the total number of attendees requested is fixed after the registration period ends.
If there are a large number of applicants, gardians of minors might be prioritized.

### The roles of judge and scrambler
According to regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors must be prepared to perform duties as judges, scramblers and other rolles required. 
For younger competitors or those unable to fulfill these roles, we may ask parents or guardians to assist on their behalf. Staff procedures will be lectured at the venue.

items.name: CuBeaulieu Craze 2024
items.information:
## VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind.

## SPONSORSHIP

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzgyMjgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d1f95f10cca6c70419c1d2f0af053c637d4fdb6f/Cubestuff%20Small-Photoroom.jpg)
A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who will be the sponsor for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.
You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online.


## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS
Please be aware that we will likely run ahead of schedule throughout the weekend. Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time.


## NOTICE OF FILMING

Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending.


#### About CubingZA

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc4NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--32984d244f55e182cf16e089cf3f8466caffc2ac/image.png)

CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, [please get in touch.](https://cubingza.org/contact)

---

Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

This year, hosted at the Centro Boliviano-Americano in the city of Santa Cruz de la Sierra, this tournament will provide a unique venue for all competitors to showcase their skills and speed in the different categories.

This competition is open to all public.
To see all the information about register payment go to the next [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaNationals2024#48693-instrucciones-de-pago)

Bolivia Nationals 2024, en su quinta edición, el Campeonato Nacional del Cubo de Rubik buscará reunir a los mejores speedcubers del país. Este año, con sede en el Centro Boliviano-Americano, en la ciudad de Santa Cruz de la Sierra, este torneo ofrecerá un espacio único para que todos los competidores demuestren sus habilidades y velocidad en las diferentes categorías.

Esta competencia esta abierta a todo publico.
Para ver la informacion acerca del pago de inscripcion entra al siguiente [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaNationals2024#48693-instrucciones-de-pago)

items.information:
## NOTE: This competition will be held on a Sunday!

## PSU students must leave their PSU email as a comment on their registration to qualify for the discounted registration fee of $10. The full registration fee ($25) must be paid, and then qualifying registrations will receive the refund.

## Competitors may bring at most one guest. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue.

## In accordance with University policy all competitors 17 years of age and younger MUST have their legal guardian accompanying them to this competition.

## All proceeds from the event will be going to the PSU Rubik's Cube Club.

* Competitors may bring at most one guest.
* Heritage Hall is located on the first floor of the HUB. This is NOT the same room as Happy Valley Spring 2024. To easily get to Heritage Hall inside the HUB-Robeson Center, you may take any of the elevators on the food court level up to the first floor **except for the elevator next to the Panda Express/Sbarro shops**. From there, Heritage Hall should be just within range to your left or right.
* The organizing team strongly recommends receiving a COVID-19 vaccination before competing. For information on, and finding vaccines near you, please use [this website](https://www.vaccines.gov/)!
* If you have symptoms related to COVID-19 such as cough, fever, shortness of breath, etc. do not attend this competition.
* If you have had a positive COVID-19 test or prolonged exposure to someone with the virus within 14 days prior to the competition, do not attend.
* By registering for this competition, you agree that you understand all the information presented in this tab, will abide by all the COVID-19 restrictions placed on this competition, and acknowledge the risk of contracting COVID-19 or any other disease in attending an event of this scale.

Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most five (5) events**.

Want to know when the next competition is? Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

Η μέρα που όλη η ελληνική κοινότητα cubing περιμένει έρχεται ξανά! 
2o Πανελλήνιο Πρωτάθλημα Cubing! 
Το 2024 έγιναν οι περισσότεροι διαγωνισμοί στην Ελλάδα από κάθε άλλη χρονιά, οπότε δεν θα μπορούσε αυτό το ταξίδι να μην τελειώσει με αυτή τη μεγάλη γιορτή!

Παρακαλούμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες σχετικά με το Πανελλήνιο Πρωτάθλημα του 2024.

Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι:

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz.

**ATENÇÃO:** Competidores menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge.

**ATTENTION:** Competitors under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.

items.information:
## VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind.

## SPONSORSHIP

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzgyMjcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d2d863a4d2dedc89e489091eae12bffb06986edb/menlyn.png)
[Menlyn Park](https://www.menlynpark.co.za) is the main host for this event. A big thank you to the events department from Menlyn Park that has gone to very far lengths to provide us with their facilities and equipment for this competition.
Menlyn Park is also providing prizes through store partners in all different categories for this event.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzgyMjgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d1f95f10cca6c70419c1d2f0af053c637d4fdb6f/Cubestuff%20Small-Photoroom.jpg)
A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who will co host and provide prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.
You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online.


## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS
Please be aware that we will likely run ahead of schedule throughout the weekend. Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time.
To all competitors competing in the 3x3-Blinfolded event - Please be aware that the venue is located in a busy shopping centre and that there will likely be a lot of distractions during the event.


## NOTICE OF FILMING

Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending.


#### About CubingZA

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc4NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--32984d244f55e182cf16e089cf3f8466caffc2ac/image.png)



CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, [please get in touch.](https://cubingza.org/contact)

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzcxMTgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--65176dceb5a653113b9a7ce41294d2d1043cdf37/yollotl.png)
**ESPAÑOL**
El amor por los cubos va más allá de solo resolver un rompecabezas; es una pasión que desafía la mente, agudiza la concentración y une a personas con el mismo entusiasmo. En la competencia Yollotl Tlaxcala 2024, te invitamos a ser parte de esta experiencia única, donde no solo pondrás a prueba tu habilidad y velocidad, sino que también compartirás momentos inolvidables con una comunidad vibrante de cuberos.
Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

**English**
The love for cubes goes beyond just solving a puzzle; it's a passion that challenges the mind, sharpens focus, and brings together people who share the same enthusiasm. At the Yollotl Tlaxcala 2024 competition, we invite you to be part of this unique experience, where you'll not only test your skill and speed but also share unforgettable moments with a vibrant community of cubers.
This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) prior to competition.

If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (12:00 AM UTC 11-13-2024)
This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!
